name: Multiple Myeloma with Spinal Involvement
definition: Clonal plasma-cell malignancy that may involve vertebrae and other bones, causing lytic lesions, pathological fractures, anemia, renal dysfunction, hypercalcemia and neural compression.

redFlags.item: Sepsis or pathological fracture with instability

core: General examination for anemia, dehydration and infection

investigations.principle: Diagnosis requires hematologic evaluation including monoclonal protein studies, marrow assessment and modern skeletal imaging.
investigations.MRI: Whole-body low-dose CT, PET/CT or MRI is selected according to guideline and clinical question.
investigations.radiographs: Plain skeletal survey is less sensitive than modern imaging and is no longer preferred in many pathways.

green: Treat complications such as hypercalcemia, renal dysfunction, infection and fracture
amber: Ayurvedic/supportive therapies must not delay oncologic treatment or cord-compression pathways.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi/Majja-dhatu involvement may be described as a parallel framework only; myeloma remains a specific hematologic malignancy.

patientEducation.summary: Clonal plasma-cell malignancy that may involve vertebrae and other bones, causing lytic lesions, pathological fractures, anemia, renal dysfunction, hypercalcemia and neural compression.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
